title: Llama in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='8' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8d7b0'/>
  <rect x='48' y='72' width='8' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8d7b0'/>
  <rect x='62' y='72' width='8' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8d7b0'/>
  <rect x='74' y='72' width='8' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8d7b0'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='33' y='88' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#a8845a'/>
  <rect x='47' y='88' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#a8845a'/>
  <rect x='61' y='88' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#a8845a'/>
  <rect x='73' y='88' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#a8845a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='62' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#f5e6c4'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='14' height='36' rx='7' fill='#f5e6c4'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <rect x='27' y='44' width='22' height='9' rx='4' fill='#e0556b'/>
  <rect x='27' y='44' width='22' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f78fa0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='46' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e0556b'/>
  <rect x='44' y='46' width='3' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#f78fa0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='28' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f5e6c4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='15' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#e8d7b0' transform='rotate(-15 26 15)'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='15' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#e8d7b0' transform='rotate(15 48 15)'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='16' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#f7b9c2' transform='rotate(-15 27 16)'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='16' rx='2.5' ry='5' fill='#f7b9c2' transform='rotate(15 47 16)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='34' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#fbeed2'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='26' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a1e'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='26' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a1e'/>
  <circle cx='32.8' cy='25.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='25.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='33' rx='2.6' ry='2' fill='#c98a8a'/>
  <path d='M26 37 q4 3 8 0' stroke='#c98a8a' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='58' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#e8d7b0'/>
</svg>
